title: Save hundreds on flights with this lifetime deal hunter
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: A lifetime Matt’s Flights Premium subscription is $39.99 (MSRP $194), with 3+ deals per week, unlimited custom search requests, and 1-on-1 travel planning support.

Airfare prices swing by hundreds of dollars depending on when you book, and most of the best deals disappear before you even know they exist. But unless you want to spend your free time refreshing airline sites, you need someone watching for you.

Matt’s Flights Premium does exactly that. A lifetime subscription is on sale for $39.99 (MSRP $194), and it puts a team of flight analysts on the job of finding mistake fares and steep discounts across 60+ US airports and six Canadian cities. Premium members get 3+ deals per week sent straight to their inbox, and Matt’s Flights says the average savings per flight is $500+.

Where the plan really earns its price is the personal side. You get unlimited custom search requests, so you can name a destination and get pricing research back, plus 1-on-1 travel planning support over email whenever you need it. Matt’s Flights has been featured in the New York Times and Thrillist.

One booking at $500 off more than pays for the lifetime cost of this plan, and every deal after that is pure savings.

Get a lifetime subscription to Matt’s Flights Premium on sale for $39.99 (MSRP $194).
